data.description:
Build the future of architecture

1zu100 is automating construction planning. Together with exceptional architecture firms, we plan multi-unit residential buildings and deliver completed, permitted plans as a service.

TL;DR

We are looking for one cracked founding engineer to build the AI that plans large residential buildings end to end: the agent harness, the data and context layer, and the evals. You work in a small, high-agency team on real projects that ship right away.

Your role

  • Harness engineering: You build and run the layer around the model end to end: memory, tool orchestration, verification, drawing and document generation, so the output stays consistent and code-compliant at scale.

  • Data and context: You turn messy planning data (CAD/BIM models, PDFs, site surveys, building codes) into the right context at every phase, always traceable back to its source.

  • Evals and benchmarks: You build the eval harness (datasets, regression tests) and measure our agents against the architectural rule sets and judgment calls.

  • BIM and IFC automation: You connect to the architect's toolchain (Revit, ArchiCAD, IFC) to drive automated modeling and clean interoperability.

Your profile

  • Hands-on experience with harness engineering: agents, tool orchestration, evals.

  • High agency and an entrepreneurial drive. Ideally, you have founded before or want to. You find the work yourself and move fast.

  • Experience in a high-growth environment (startup, scale-up or similar).

  • Nice to have: German, Revit, IFC or Grasshopper, a non-linear CV and experiments with reinforcement learning (MCTS, GRPO, RLHF) or diffusion models (discrete and continuous).

What we offer

  • A fast-paced environment at a fast-growing startup, with a steep learning curve

  • Competitive salary and a stake in the company, with first-hire upside

  • Real projects that ship right away

  • You build right alongside the founders, in the same codebase on the same hard problems

  • Wellpass and unlimited coffee from a professional barista

We're a small team with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and change the way construction planning is done, you're the one we need.

How we hire

  1. Apply here.

  2. An intro call with the founders.

  3. A technical interview.

  4. A trial day on-site in Munich. We pick a problem together and build it side by side.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

Don't meet every requirement? Please apply anyway. If our mission speaks to you, we'd love to hear from you.

Standort: MVZ Hochfranken Fachärzte

Anstellungsverhältnis: Unbefristet

Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit (40 Std. / Woche)

Eintrittsdatum: Ab sofort

Über uns

Das MVZ Hochfranken Fachärzte steht für eine moderne, fachübergreifende und patientenorientierte ambulante Versorgung. Um unsere Betriebsabläufe kontinuierlich zu optimieren, gesetzliche Vorgaben sicher umzusetzen und unser nicht-ärztliches Team bestmöglich zu führen, suchen wir ab sofort eine erfahrene und engagierte Persönlichkeit für das Praxismanagement.

Ihre Aufgaben

· Betriebs- & Praxisorganisation:

o Verantwortliche/r Ansprechpartner/in für Patienten, Angehörige, Zuweiser, Ärzte und Mitarbeiter in allen praxisrelevanten Belangen.

o Vorausschauende Überwachung der Terminplan-Auslastung sowie aktives Patienten- und Beschwerdemanagement.

o Sicherstellung und Überwachung interner Betriebsabläufe (u. a. Endoskopie, Sonografie, Kardiologie, Gynäkologie) sowie Steuerung von Hygiene-, IT- und Arbeitsschutzstandards.

· Personalverantwortung & Führung:

o Disziplinarische und fachliche Führung des nicht-ärztlichen Personals und der Verwaltung.

o Gestaltung des On- und Offboardings, Dienst- und Urlaubsplanung sowie Mitarbeiterentwicklung und -motivation.

o Sicherstellung einer effizienten Einarbeitung neuer Mitarbeiter

o Personalbedarfsplanung

o Durchführung von Personalgesprächen in Abstimmung mit der ärztlichen Leitung.

o Vorbereitung der monatlichen Lohnabrechnung und Zuarbeit für die Buchhaltung/HR.

· KV-Formalia, Abrechnung & Controlling:

o Beantragung von KV-Anträgen für Genehmigungen beschäftigter Ärzte und Nachbesetzungsverfahren.

o Mitarbeit bei der Überwachung der Vollständigkeit und Plausibilität der EBM- und GOÄ-Abrechnungen gemäß KV-Richtlinien.

o Überwachung und Einhaltung von Abrechnungsmodalitäten (Zeitprofile, Scheinsplitting, RLV, TSVG) sowie Budget- und Regresskontrolle in Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung und ärztlichen Leitung.

o Auswertung von Kennzahlen (KPIs), Ausgaben-/Einkaufscontrolling und Mitwirkung bei der Standortentwicklung.

· Qualitätsmanagement, Schnittstellen & Kommunikation:

o Aufbau, Überwachung und kontinuierliche Aktualisierung des Qualitätsmanagements (QM) und der Formulare/Vorlagen.

o Schnittstelle und Ansprechpartner/in für Kassenärztliche Vereinigungen (KVB), Behörden, Medizintechnik-Dienstleister und externe Kooperationspartner.

o Vorbereitung und Leitung von Teambesprechungen sowie enge Abstimmung mit der Geschäftsführung und der ärztlichen Leitung.

· Organisatorische und technische Weiterentwicklung

o Unterstützung bei der Implementierung neuer Software sowie Digitalisierung und Optimierung des Patientenbetriebs, Vereinfachung von Arbeitsabläufen, Standardisierung und Fehlervermeidung

o Einbringung in übergeordnete Projekte der Gruppe (Pilotierung von KI, IT- Projekten und Medizinprodukten oder der Abrechnungsoptimierung oder der Entwicklung von Behandlungsstandards als Beispiele)

o Schnittstellenmanagement zwischen Regionalgeschäftsführung, Ärztlichem Leiter und Verwaltung

Ihr Profil

· Erfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Praxisverwaltung, im MVZ-Management oder einer vergleichbaren Führungsposition im Gesundheitswesen.

· Qualifikation: Weiterbildung oder Studium im Gesundheitswesen (z. B. Fachwirt/in für ambulante medizinische Versorgung, Fachwirt/in im Gesundheits- und Sozialwesen, Gesundheitsökonom/in) oder fundierte medizinische bzw. kaufmännische Ausbildung mit Praxisleitungserfahrung.

· Fachkenntnisse:

o Fundierte Kenntnisse in der EBM- und GOÄ-Abrechnung sowie im KV-Recht/Vertragsarztrecht.

o Sicheres Verständnis kassenärztlicher Antrags- und Genehmigungsverfahren für Ärzte.

o Routine im Umgang mit Praxisverwaltungssystemen (PVS) und MS Office.

· Soft Skills:

o Durchsetzungsstarke, kommunikative und empathische Führungspersönlichkeit.

o Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise und ausgeprägtes organisatorisches Geschick.

o Hohe Serviceorientierung, Belastbarkeit und Konfliktfähigkeit.

Was wir Ihnen bieten

· Zukunftssicherheit: Ein unbefristetes Arbeitsverhältnis in Vollzeit in einer verantwortungsvollen Schlüsselposition.

· Gestaltungsspielraum: Eigenständiges Arbeiten mit viel Raum für die Einbringung eigener Ideen und Prozessoptimierungen.

· Kultur & Team: Ein kollegiales, eingespieltes Team sowie flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege.

· Entwicklung: Gezielte Förderung durch Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.

data.title: People Operations Specialist (m/w/d)

data.description:
Wir sind hey contact heroes, ein Kundenservice-Dienstleister aus dem Herzen von Hamburg, im Zentrum der HafenCity. Seit 2021 betreuen wir für Marken wie Telefónica, 1&1, Universal Music, Check24, Hamburg Wasser und enviaM deren Kundinnen und Kunden am Telefon, per Mail und im Chat. Mehr als 500 Teammitglieder arbeiten bei uns europaweit remote, und in den letzten Jahren sind wir jedes Jahr um 8 bis 10 Prozent gewachsen.

Für unsere Projekte suchen wir eine Person, die das Workforce Management bei uns fest in die Hand nimmt, von Forecast und Schichtplanung über die Intraday-Steuerung bis zur Automatisierung unserer Planungs- und Reportingtools. Die Stelle ist eine Vollzeitstelle, zu 100 % remote und kann von überall in Europa besetzt werden.

Aufgaben

Du erstellst Forecasts für das Kontaktvolumen, leitest daraus den Personalbedarf ab und baust bedarfsgerechte Einsatz- und Schichtpläne mit sinnvollen Schichtrotationen, abgestimmt auf Verfügbarkeiten, Qualifikationen und Skills. Im Tagesgeschäft hast du Servicelevel, Erreichbarkeit, Produktivität und Auslastung im Blick und steuerst intraday nach, wenn es nötig ist. Du planst den Personaleinsatz über mehrere Projekte und Skills hinweg, auch im Blending, und achtest auf Schichttreue und die Einhaltung geplanter Arbeitszeiten.

Du analysierst unsere WFM- und Performancekennzahlen, vergleichst Forecast und tatsächliches Aufkommen und leitest daraus konkrete Verbesserungen ab.

Genauso wichtig ist die technische Seite. Du entwickelst unsere serverbasierten Planungs- und Schichtplanungstools weiter, passt Planungslogiken, Kapazitätssteuerung und Buchungsprozesse an und automatisierst Reportings, vor allem mit Google Apps Script, Google Sheets und Datenschnittstellen. Du pflegst und verbesserst unsere automatisierten Abrechnungs- und Controllingtools, betreust Datenimporte und Schnittstellen und sorgst dafür, dass die Daten stimmen. Wo heute noch viel von Hand läuft, findest du einen Weg, es zu automatisieren.

Qualifikation

Du hast mehrere Jahre Erfahrung im Workforce Management, idealerweise im Contact Center oder Kundenservice, und kennst Forecasting, Schichtplanung und Intraday-Steuerung aus der Praxis. Kennzahlen wie Servicelevel, Erreichbarkeit, AHT, Auslastung und Schichttreue sind für dich Alltag.

Du bist technisch fit. Google Sheets beherrschst du richtig gut, mit Google Apps Script oder JavaScript hast du schon eigene Lösungen gebaut, und Datenschnittstellen, Importe und SQL schrecken dich nicht ab. Erfahrung mit WFM-Software oder Dialersystemen ist ein Plus.

Du arbeitest strukturiert und zuverlässig, behältst auch an hektischen Tagen den Überblick und stimmst dich gut mit Projekt- und Teamleitungen ab. Deutsch sprichst du auf muttersprachlichem Niveau oder mindestens auf C1/C2.

Du vor der Kamera. KRUU im Feed.

Brand Face & Content Creator (m/w/d) – Social Video

Bad Friedrichshall & Heilbronn | ⏰ ca. 20 Std./Woche | Start ab Januar

Du kennst diesen Moment, wenn du eigentlich nur kurz Instagram öffnen wolltest – und 45 Minuten später immer noch Reels schaust?

Perfekt.

Denn wir suchen niemanden, der Social Media nur „mitbetreut“.

Wir suchen ein Gesicht für KRUU. Vielleicht deins.

KRUU ist Europas Nummer 1 für mobile Fotoboxen auf Hochzeiten, Geburtstagen und Events und wächst aktuell stark – auch in den USA. Und genau das wollen wir zeigen: auf Social Media, nahbar, unterhaltsam und vor allem so, dass man nicht nach zwei Sekunden weiterscrollt**.**

Du wirst vor der Kamera stehen, Geschichten erzählen, Trends aufgreifen, unsere Produkte erklären und gemeinsam mit unserem Social-Media-Team Content entwickeln, der sich eben nicht nach Unternehmenscontent anfühlt.

Kurz gesagt:

Du sollst KRUU nicht nur zeigen. Du sollst KRUU ein Gesicht geben.

Was du bei uns machst

Du stehst regelmäßig vor der Kamera und setzt gemeinsam entwickelte Content-Ideen in Reels und Social Videos um.

Du bekommst aber nicht einfach nur fertige Skripte vorgelegt. Wir wollen deine Ideen, deinen Humor und dein Gespür dafür, was gerade funktioniert.

Du wirst unter anderem:

  • vor der Kamera stehen und Content für unsere Social-Media-Kanäle produzieren
  • deine Videos selbst schneiden – dynamisch, modern und ohne unnötiges Blabla
  • eigene Content-Ideen entwickeln und spontan Trends aufgreifen
  • wissen, welcher Sound, welches Format oder welcher Hook gerade funktioniert
  • unsere Produkte so erklären, dass man sie versteht und trotzdem weiterschauen möchte
  • Content für unseren deutschen und englischsprachigen Auftritt umsetzen
  • eng mit unserem Social-Media-Team zusammenarbeiten

Und manchmal heißt Content bei uns eben auch:

Kamera schnappen. Idee ausprobieren. Schauen, ob sie funktioniert.

Nicht alles muss erst durch zwölf Abstimmungsschleifen.

Könnte ziemlich gut passen, wenn …

… du dich vor einer Kamera wohler fühlst als dahinter versteckt.

… du beim Scrollen automatisch denkst:
„Der Einstieg ist gut.“ „Das hätte ich anders geschnitten.“ oder
„Okay, den Trend könnten wir sofort für KRUU nutzen.“

… du bereits Content produziert hast und Kamera, Licht und Schnitt keine Fremdwörter für dich sind.

… du Menschen mit deiner Art mitnehmen kannst, ohne dich dafür zu verstellen.

… du Dinge einfach, unterhaltsam und auf den Punkt erklären kannst.

… dein Deutsch und Englisch so gut sind, dass du dich in beiden Sprachen sicher vor der Kamera bewegen kannst.

Und ganz wichtig:

Followerzahlen sind uns weniger wichtig als Persönlichkeit.

Wir suchen keinen fertigen Influencer.
Wir suchen jemanden mit Ausstrahlung, Kreativität und richtig viel Lust auf Content.

Was du von KRUU bekommst

Natürlich gibt's bei uns mehr als Ringlicht und WLAN.

Du arbeitest grundsätzlich flexibel – nur wenn gedreht wird, brauchen wir dich natürlich vor Ort. Dazu kommen anteilig 30 Tage Urlaub, Sonderurlaub, monatliche Physiotherapie, kostenlose Getränke und Snacks und täglich Mittagessen – unter anderem frisch gekocht von unserem eigenen Koch.

Außerdem bekommst du bei uns:

Budget für Kurse, Workshops, Weiterbildungen und Konferenzen

die KRUU Fotobox kostenlos für deine eigenen Events

Season Opening, Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier und Team-Events

ein modernes Office direkt am Neckar

Und vor allem ziemlich viel Raum, deinen eigenen Stil einzubringen und diese Rolle mitzugestalten.

Und jetzt kommt deine Bewerbung.

Bitte kein klassisches Anschreiben.

Schick uns lieber ein kurzes Video von dir – 30 bis 60 Sekunden reichen vollkommen.

Handy raus, Kamera an und erzähl uns:

Wer bist du – in einem Satz?

Warum hast du Lust, das Gesicht von KRUU zu werden?

Welchen Content hast du zuletzt selbst produziert?

Und was braucht ein Reel, damit du nicht weiterscrollst?

Wenn du einen Instagram-/TikTok-Account, ein Portfolio oder Arbeitsproben hast: her damit.

Das Video muss weder perfekt geschnitten noch komplett durchproduziert sein. Uns interessiert viel mehr, wie du vor der Kamera wirkst und wer du bist. Genau diesen unkomplizierten Bewerbungsweg habt ihr auch in der bisherigen Stellenbeschreibung vorgesehen.

Ready to be the face behind the feed?

data.description:
Your mission

You train the technical teams of strategic cloud partners to build, integrate and support AI applications with confidence. Your audience is solution architects, field engineers, developers, technical consultants and sales engineering teams.

You take a proven AI curriculum and make it work for cloud partner audiences: real deployment scenarios, partner-specific examples, live troubleshooting. You are the technical face of our client in the room.


Your tasks include:

  • Deliver instructor-led bootcamps, technical workshops, train-the-trainer sessions and hands-on labs for cloud partner organisations.
  • Adapt core AI training content for partner audiences such as solution architects, field engineers, developers and partner enablement leaders.
  • Translate AI capabilities into practical cloud scenarios, reference architectures and customer-facing use cases.
  • Lead practical exercises on how to build, integrate, deploy, evaluate and support AI applications in cloud environments.
  • Troubleshoot participant issues live, from lab setup and API calls to code samples and implementation questions.
  • Work with program leadership and partner enablement stakeholders to refine delivery plans and localise examples.
  • Keep delivery quality high across regions, cohorts and groups with different technical maturity.
  • Capture recurring knowledge gaps and recommend improvements to content, labs and facilitation guides.


Your profile

You move comfortably between developer-level detail, cloud architecture context and an executive-friendly explanation. You are energised by teaching complex material and you earn credibility with engineers by knowing your stuff.


Experience & Education

  • More than 5 years of professional experience in technical training, developer education, solution architecture, technical consulting, partner engineering, software development or cloud enablement.
  • Experience delivering technical workshops, bootcamps, labs or train-the-trainer sessions for professional audiences.
  • Strong practical fluency with generative AI, LLM concepts, prompt engineering, APIs, SDKs and modern AI application patterns.
  • Hands-on familiarity with cloud platforms and partner environments such as AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure or Oracle Cloud.
  • Fluent English; a second language (French, Spanish or German) is a strong plus.
  • Located in or near a major EMEA city with an airport (for example Munich or Frankfurt).
  • Willingness to travel for partner workshops and regional programs (approx. 25-35%).
  • Of advantage: familiarity with Amazon Bedrock (AWS Bedrock).
  • Of advantage: experience enabling cloud partners, hyperscalers, systems integrators or partner field organisations.
  • Of advantage: experience building hands-on labs, certification pathways or partner academies.

Skills & Attributes

  • Explains cloud and AI concepts clearly to engineers, architects and business stakeholders alike.
  • Facilitates live technical labs and solves setup, code and API issues on the spot.
  • Strong executive presence and professional conduct with senior partner stakeholders.
  • Adapts content and communication style to different proficiency levels, regions and roles.
  • Reads, explains and lightly modifies sample code in Python or JavaScript.
  • Understands RAG, vector search, AI agents and workflow orchestration well enough to teach them.
  • Of advantage: experience with developer relations, sales engineering enablement or solution architect training.


Why us?

You teach AI to the people who bring it to enterprise customers, with a premium learner experience as the standard.

Impact: Your sessions build the technical confidence that drives AI adoption across partner field teams in EMEA.

Responsibility: You own the delivery quality of your workshops and represent a leading AI company directly with strategic partners.

Dynamics: AI products change fast, and so does your content; you work in a small team that decides quickly.

Development: Product training and credentialing are provided, and you grow into a specialist role in a new, high-visibility training program.


Benefits

  • Home office and workation possibility
  • Flexible working hours
  • Subsidised EGYM Wellpass
  • Apple hardware (laptop & iPhone)


These are the recruiting steps that await you:

  1. Culture Fit - Get to know Rike or Kim from our People team. Learn more about nonplusultra and our culture.
  2. Content & Role Fit Interview - Go deeper into the role with Matze Schulz and a technical colleague from OpenAI.
  3. Case Study - Work through a practical training scenario together with Matze Schulz and a technical colleague from OpenAI.

Deine Mission bei ]init[

Du willst Digitalisierung dort vorantreiben, wo sie gesellschaftlich wirklich zählt? Als Senior Project Manager (all genders) gestaltest und steuerst du anspruchsvolle digitale Verwaltungsprojekte rund um Migration & Inneres. Du bringst Kund:innen, Fachlichkeit und Technologie zusammen und machst aus komplexen Anforderungen digitale Lösungen, die in der Praxis funktionieren.


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Du realisierst anspruchsvolle IT- und Digitalisierungsprojekte von gesellschaftlicher Relevanz mit besonderem Fokus auf die Fachthemen Migration & Inneres – agil oder hybrid.
  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Projekte über die gesamte Projektlaufzeit und steuerst Scope, Time, Budget, Qualität und Risiken.
  • Du arbeitest mit interdisziplinäre Projektteams, in unterschiedlichen technologischen Kontexten – von digitalen Verwaltungsleistungen und Fachanwendungen über Content- und Formular-Management-Systeme bis hin zu individuellen IT-Lösungen zusammen und sorgst für eine strukturierte und verlässliche Zusammenarbeit innerhalb des Projekts.
  • Als zentrale Schnittstelle koordinierst du interne und externe Stakeholder und arbeitest eng mit unseren Kund:innen aus der öffentlichen Verwaltung zusammen. Gemeinsam mit interdisziplinären Teams übersetzt du die Anforderungen unserer Kund:innen in tragfähige IT-Lösungen und digitale Prozesse und begleitest deren Umsetzung von der Konzeption bis zum erfolgreichen Go-live.
  • Du begleitest unsere Kund:innen bei Fragestellungen rund um die digitale Transformation und erkennst dabei auch Potenziale für die Weiterentwicklung bestehender Projekte und Lösungen.

Über ]init[

Du möchtest die Gesellschaft von morgen mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei ]init[ richtig. Denn unsere digitalen Lösungen sind für Menschen gemacht und haben gesellschaftliche Relevanz. Klingt spannend? Dann steig ein und arbeite gemeinsam mit über 1.400 ]init[s in interdisziplinären Teams an unseren sieben Standorten – oder flexibel von überall in Deutschland aus.


Deine Mission bei ]init[

Du willst die digitale Verwaltung von morgen mitgestalten – dort, wo sie für Menschen unmittelbar spürbar wird? Als Senior Consultant (all genders) für digitale Verwaltungsprojekte im Fachbereich Migration & Inneres berätst du unsere Kund:innen bei anspruchsvollen Digitalisierungsvorhaben in einem gesellschaftlich und politisch hochrelevanten Umfeld. Du durchdringst komplexe fachliche und organisatorische Fragestellungen, entwickelst tragfähige Zielbilder und Lösungsansätze und bringst Fachlichkeit, Verwaltung und Technologie zusammen. Dabei endet Beratung für dich nicht beim Konzept: Gemeinsam mit interdisziplinären Teams begleitest du Lösungen von der ersten Fragestellung bis in die erfolgreiche Umsetzung.


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Du berätst unsere Kund:innen aus der öffentlichen Verwaltung bei anspruchsvollen IT- und Digitalisierungsvorhaben mit besonderem Fokus auf Migration & Inneres sowie Themen der Inneren Sicherheit und gestaltest mit unseren Kund:innen gemeinsam die Weiterentwicklung von Verwaltungsprozessen und digitalen Services, hinterfragst bestehende Abläufe und bereitest fachliche Entscheidungen strukturiert vor.
  • Du arbeitest dich tief in komplexe fachliche Zusammenhänge ein, analysierst fachliche, organisatorische und prozessuale Fragestellungen und entwickelst daraus Zielbilder, Handlungsoptionen und konkrete Empfehlungen.
  • Du konzipierst und moderierst Workshops, Interviews und Abstimmungsformate, führst unterschiedliche Perspektiven zusammen und begleitest Kund:innen und weitere Stakeholder durch Entscheidungs- und Veränderungsprozesse.
  • Du bringst Verwaltung, Fachlichkeit und Technologie zusammen, strukturierst und priorisierst Anforderungen und übersetzt fachliche Bedarfe gemeinsam mit interdisziplinären Projekt- und Entwicklungsteams in tragfähige digitale Lösungen.
  • Du begleitest die Umsetzung deiner Konzepte bis in die Praxis – von Analyse und Anforderungsaufnahme über Konzeption, Pilotierung und Tests bis zum Go-live – und behältst dabei Nutzer, Akzeptanz und die nachhaltige Verankerung der Lösungen im Blick.


Das bringst du mit

  • Du bringst relevante Erfahrung in der Beratung von Kund:innen des Public Sectors im Kontext von IT-, Digitalisierungs- oder Transformationsvorhaben mit und hast bereits eigenständig Beratungsaufgaben oder fachliche Arbeitspakete verantwortet.
  • Du kannst dich schnell und fundiert in komplexe Fachthemen einarbeiten, Zusammenhänge analysieren und strukturieren sowie daraus belastbare Handlungsoptionen, Empfehlungen, Zielbilder und Konzepte ableiten.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit externen Kund:innen und unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern und bewegst dich kommunikativ sicher auf verschiedenen Ebenen der Kund:innen- und Projektorganisation.
  • Du fühlst dich nicht nur in der fachlichen Beratung wohl, sondern möchtest deine Konzepte gemeinsam mit interdisziplinären Teams in die Umsetzung bringen und ihre Wirkung in der Praxis erleben.
  • Du bringst bereits praktische Erfahrung im Themenfeld Migration & Inneres bzw. Innere Sicherheit mit und kennst die fachlichen Herausforderungen und Rahmenbedingungen dieses Umfelds.
  • Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung mit Digitalisierungsvorhaben der öffentlichen Verwaltung und/oder einen fachlichen Bezug zu Migration, Inneres oder Innerer Sicherheit mit. Kenntnisse rund um OZG, EfA, FIM, Datenschutz oder IT-Service-Management sind ein Plus.
  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium bildet idealerweise die fachliche Grundlage für deine Tätigkeit.
  • Du bringst sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie gute Englischkenntnisse mit.


Das bieten wir dir

  • Because we care: 30 Urlaubstage und Workation innerhalb der EU schaffen Freiraum für Erholung und neue Perspektiven. So lassen sich Beruf und Privatleben gut miteinander verbinden.
  • Work with us: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten und Teilzeitmodelle ermöglichen dir, Arbeit und Alltag passend zu gestalten – immer abgestimmt mit deinem Team und deinen Projekten.
  • Learn with us: Mit der ]init[ Academy, Trainings, Zertifizierungen und bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch entwickelst du dich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Grow with us: Profitiere von bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch und entwickle dich gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleg:innen kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Ride with us: JobRad, ÖPNV-Zuschuss und weitere Mobility Benefits unterstützen dich dabei, flexibel und nachhaltig unterwegs zu sein.
  • Start with us: Welcome Week, strukturiertes Onboarding und Patenschaften sorgen für einen gelungenen Einstieg und helfen dir, schnell im Team und deinen Projekten anzukommen.


Werde Teil des Teams

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft – in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, remote oder im Office.
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.
Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit sind für uns selbstverständlich. Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung und Gleichstellung begrüßen wir ausdrücklich.
  
Sicherheit wichtig ist, kann je nach Position nach einer Zusage eine vertrauliche Sicherheitsüberprüfung erforderlich sein.


Recruiter

Anne Kroll

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is seeking a high-impact, strategic seller to lead the go-to-market execution for our newest frontiers in Connected Equipment.  As an Enterprise Specialist (Overlay), you will partner with our Account Executives (AEs) to build deep partnerships with our largest, most complex accounts. You aren't just selling a tool; you are pioneering GTM, ensuring our customers realize continuous value from new products as a part of the overall platform.

This specialist reports into the VP of Sales, EMEA and will be aligned by segment and product.  AEs on the team are charged with accelerating the growth of one or more new product(s) and will be incentivized on quarterly product sales targets mapped to mainline sellers in the segment.   Product Specialist sellers drive growth through strategic, high-value deal executing and enabling the segment overall to be successful.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United Kingdom.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you're meeting with a VP of Operations in waste management; the next, you're diving into the logistics of a global food distributor. You seek to understand the "unit of value" for every customer.
  • You build genuine, high-stakes relationships: Our customers operate in "boots-on-the-ground" industries. They value earned trust and partners who understand their operational realities.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. 
  • You are a team Player: In an overlay role, your success is tied to the success of the broader account team. You lead through influence, not just authority.

In this role, you will: 

  • Architect deals that align Samsara's new products value with customer use cases to provide maximum value and return on investment
  • Co-generate new product pipeline with ADRs/AEs across high propensity to buy accounts
  • Drive strategy and pilot/trial success 
  • Provide commercial insights and pricing benchmarks often for unique set of competitors in the market
  • Partner with GTM and Product to feed back insights and help shape roadmap
  • Build frameworks, assets and insights that scale across the sales org
  • Travel 20%+ to meet customers where they physically operate and to advance solutions and deals
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years in complex, full-cycle Enterprise sales.
  • Proven Track Record: Consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts with £500k+/€500k+ ARR transactions.
  • Deal Complexity: Demonstrated success navigating 6- and 7-figure deals involving multiple stakeholders (Legal, Procurement, InfoSec, and C-Suite).
  • Entrepreneurial Agility: Experience selling new products where the playbook is still being written.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working in a specialist/overlay co-selling with a mainline AE team.
  • Second language experience in French or German at business-level proficiency.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Role overview:

North is Cohere’s AI workspace platform for enterprises: a secure, customizable environment where companies can use AI across their real workflows while maintaining control over sensitive data. North connects AI agents with workplace tools, applications, and business context, helping users delegate complex work, build automations, inspect outputs, and collaborate with AI in production environments.

As North becomes more capable, one of the most important questions is also one of the hardest: how do we know whether the model is actually getting better for the workflows customers care about?

This role is about being the voice of North inside modelling. You will build the evaluation systems, feedback loops, and applied modelling workflows that make sure model progress translates into better product outcomes for North users. You will work closely with North product teams, customer-facing teams, and modelling teams to define what “good” means across the product surface, turn real usage and product direction into high-quality evals, and use those evals to guide model selection, patches, and regular model updates.

This is neither a pure research role nor a conventional product engineering role. It is a rigorous applied MLE role for someone who cares deeply about measurement, model behavior, and real-world product quality. You should be excited by the craft of building careful evals: evals that capture messy agentic workflows, reflect actual customer needs, resist superficial benchmark hacking, and provide useful signal for where the product and models need to go next.

Please note: this team works closely across Europe and East Coast North America time zones. We are open to candidates who can collaborate effectively within those hours.

Key responsibilities:

  • Own the eval strategy for North: define what we need to measure across agent workflows, tool use, enterprise knowledge work such as deep research, document creation or editing, and other human-AI interactions.

  • Build high-quality evals from the realities of the product: user feedback, production failures, privacy-preserving usage logs, internal dogfooding, customer needs, and forward-looking product goals.

  • Create systems that continuously turn what North is learning from users, customers, and feature teams into evals, so measurement keeps pace with the product rather than becoming a static benchmark.

  • Be the voice of North inside modelling: extract clear insight from eval results, customer-derived data and product context, then turn model failures, capability gaps, and North-specific needs into actionable recommendations for the central modelling teams.

Qualifications:

  • You have improved LLM-powered, agent-powered, or AI-product systems through evals, feedback loops, data curation, prompting, model adaptation, or model selection.

  • You care deeply about evaluation as a craft: representative tasks, precise rubrics, clean data, failure analysis, regression tracking, and knowing when a metric is giving false confidence.

  • You have strong applied MLE judgment and can reason clearly about model behavior, eval validity, product outcomes, and production tradeoffs.

  • You are comfortable working close to users and product teams, while translating messy qualitative signals into measurement that other modelling teams can act on.

  • You are self-directed, practical, and motivated by open-ended problems where the right answer requires both technical depth and product understanding.

  • You care about making AI systems genuinely useful in real enterprise settings, not just better on abstract benchmarks.

If some of the above does not line up perfectly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.

Working Location:
This role can be based remotely or from one of our office locations listed on the job description - there is no minimum in-office qualification requirement. We care most about hiring exceptional people regardless of locations, though please check the location listed on the posting for guidance around the core time zone or working hours alignment expected for the role.

Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks:

  • A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

  • Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

  • RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

  • 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

  • Annual enrichment benefits:

    Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

    Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

  • 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

  • Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How and Where We Work:

  • Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

  • For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

  • For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

  • Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form, and we will work together to meet your needs.

We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.

Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an ----- or ----- email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers page.

Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

About the role

As a Staff Research Scientist, you will join a team of 40+ researchers and engineers in our R&D department, working on the frontier of generative AI with a focus on avatar-centric, interactive video diffusion models.

This is a unique opportunity for experts in machine learning and diffusion models to shape the future of AI video agents that listen, respond, and react like humans. As part of our Interactive Avatars team, you'll build models that hold natural, real-time conversations: understanding what a user says and how they say it, then responding with appropriate turn-taking, backchannels, gaze, and facial and body reactions. You'll join a team that moves fast, iterates often, and turns breakthrough research into product capabilities that ship.


What you'll do

  • Set the research direction and roadmap for dyadic interaction modeling, balancing long-term bets with near-term product impact.

  • Advance the state of the art in the perceptual layer of interactive agents, including understanding user audio and video and generating contextually appropriate reactions.

  • Post-train multimodal models to generate rich, natural dyadic interactions from user audio and video inputs.

  • Adapt diffusion models to new conditioning signals, such as conversational state, turn-taking, and listener cues.

  • Build robust evaluation frameworks and test suites for continuous tracking of interaction quality.

  • Partner with our data team to define data needs and shape high-quality datasets.

  • Lead and mentor a small group of researchers, and drive technical decisions across research, data, and engineering.

What we're looking for:

  • Deep ML expertise and extensive hands-on experience with diffusion models, ideally for video or avatar generation.

  • A strong publication record at top-tier venues (e.g., CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, SIGGRAPH) in areas such as world models, dyadic interaction, or video diffusion, or equivalent demonstrated impact.

  • Experience leading a small team of researchers and mentoring junior members.

  • A track record of taking research from idea to production.

  • Proficiency in PyTorch and modern ML tooling for large-scale training.

  • Clear communication of hypotheses, experiments, and results, and the ability to influence direction across teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience with real-time or streaming generation, including autoregressive video diffusion.

  • Distillation or other techniques for low-latency inference.

  • Audio-driven facial, gesture, or full-body motion modeling.

  • Conversational modeling, such as turn-taking, backchanneling, or listener-response generation.

Why join us?

We’re living the golden age of AI. The next decade will yield the next iconic companies, and we dare to say we have what it takes to become one. Here’s why,

Our culture

At Synthesia we’re passionate about building, not talking, planning or politicising. We strive to hire the smartest, kindest and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work without distractions. Our work principles serve as our charter for how we make decisions, give feedback and structure our work to empower everyone to go as fast as possible. You can find out more about these principles here.

Serving 50,000+ customers (and 50% of the Fortune 500)

We’re trusted by leading brands such as Heineken, Zoom, Xerox, McDonald’s and more. Read stories from happy customers and what 1,200+ people say on G2.

Proprietary AI technology

Since 2017, we’ve been pioneering advancements in Generative AI. Our AI technology is built in-house, by a team of world-class AI researchers and engineers. Learn more about our AI Research Lab and the team behind.

AI Safety, Ethics and Security

AI safety, ethics, and security are fundamental to our mission. While the full scope of Artificial Intelligence's impact on our society is still unfolding, our position is clear: People first. Always.  Learn more about our commitments to AI Ethics, Safety & Security.

The good stuff...

  • Competitive compensation

  • Hybrid work setting with an office in London, Zurich, Munich, or remote in Europe. 

  • 25 days of annual leave + public holidays

  • Great company culture with the option to join regular planning and socials at our hubs

  • + other benefits depending on your location

You can see more about Who we are and How we work here: https://www.synthesia.io/careers

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

About the role

Synthesia ships more product, faster, than we ever have. AI has collapsed the cost of building which means the hard part is no longer making things, it’s making sure people actually adopt them. That’s the job of Growth, and we’re changing how we do it: instead of bolting Growth on after launch to optimise, we’re embedding a Growth PM into every core bet from day one, so how a product acquires, activates and scales is designed in from the first cycle.

We’re hiring a Growth Product Manager to report to our VP of Growth. You'll own the Growth surface for one of those bets while helping build a growth-led way of working across the company.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own Growth for a core product area end to end, acquisition, activation, adoption and retention, baked into the roadmap from the start, not retrofitted.

  • Partner closely with the core product PMs and engineers who own the surface, bringing high-impact growth ideas and working out where they fit, and getting the primitives exposed that let you build and scale on top.

  • Design growth into the product itself: discovery-led acquisition loops, and experiences that get users to their job-to-be-done in a couple of clicks (sometimes without opening the editor at all).

  • Rally teams around specific, measurable outcomes and help each one hit its goal faster through what you build together.

  • Work across engineering, marketing and GTM to make funnel- and journey-thinking a normal part of how we build.

Who you are

Data Scientist - Partner Flow - UK

Hybrid in London, United Kingdom

We're looking for a Data Scientist to join the Partner Flow team.

You'll use experiments and causal inference to shape how iwoca grows through its partners – the fintechs and platforms that offer iwoca lending inside their own products.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

Partner Flow owns the journey for small businesses that come to iwoca through a partner platform, from how they discover iwoca’s business finance to any repeat lending. The aim is to reach each business at the right time, make it easy to apply and get funded, and match them with the offer that suits them and works best for iwoca over time.

The team works on three parts of that journey:

  • The application. Making it smooth and collecting the data a credit decision needs.

  • Routing. Working out which applications get an automatic decision and which need input from a credit analyst.

  • Offer terms. Testing amount, duration, and interest rate, working closely with Credit Risk Modelling, who build the credit models.

The team is small and cross-functional – data science, engineering, design, and product – and works across the full application stack, from the APIs partners integrate with to the experience customers see when they apply.

The role

As the Data Scientist in Partner Flow, you'll run the analysis behind the team's product decisions. Most of it is experiment design and causal inference, with some model building and funnel analysis.

You'll own each project from the start. You'll work out what the business needs, reason from first principles, weigh the trade-offs, and shape the project with product, commercial, and strategy colleagues before deciding how it gets done. The team's analytical approach is still young, so you'll help set its methods. Around 10% of your time is for research and learning – finding better methods for the problems in front of you, or new ways to add value.

You'll work with data scientists in iwoca's other customer flow teams, and join the analytics guild – iwoca's data science community – to align on methods and build your expertise. Your results reach the wider business through Learnings – short write-ups of what an experiment found, shared at weekly and fortnightly sessions.

Live project examples:

  • Pre-qualification. Measuring how showing customers what they could borrow before they apply affects conversion and Customer Lifetime Value (CLtV), then shaping how the model behind it develops.

  • Credit cards. Working out which customers should see iwoca's recently launched credit card, a Flexi-Loan, or both – and whether the card wins extra customers or takes them from Flexi-Loan.

  • Top-up notifications. Measuring whether letting eligible customers know they can borrow more increases CLtV, using causal inference methods beyond a standard A/B test.

  • Partner funnel. Building a clear view from application to drawdown, finding where customers drop off, and testing fixes where they'll matter most.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Statistical foundations. You have a background in probability and statistics from a quantitative field – typically a degree or Master's in Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or similar. You reason about uncertainty and calibration as first-order concerns.

  • Causal inference and experimentation. You have designed and analysed experiments where separating signal from noise mattered – A/B tests, quasi-experiments, or lift studies. You know where A/B testing breaks down and what to reach for instead.

  • Commercial experience. You have used data science to shape commercial decisions – in an industry role, a consultancy, or a substantial placement – and worked alongside the people who acted on them.

  • Analytical ownership. You have taken loosely defined problems from start to finish – working out the right question, choosing the approach, and seeing the analysis through to a decision.

  • Iteration. You make the best call the current evidence allows and act on it early. As new data comes in, you update the call and tighten the answer.

  • AI leverage. You've used AI to produce work you couldn't have delivered alone – an analysis pipeline, a prototype, or a tool others use. You judge where it helps, and you check its output before anyone acts on it.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail for non-technical colleagues in commercial and strategy roles.

Bonus:

  • Causal inference beyond A/B testing. You have used synthetic control, interrupted time series, or difference-in-differences in commercial or research work.

  • Bayesian methods. You have used hierarchical models, MCMC, or Bayesian updating in real work.

  • Funnel and marketplace experience. You have analysed conversion funnels or marketplaces where products compete for customers' attention.

  • Market curiosity. You've explored how the partner lending market works – what makes a partner choose iwoca over a competitor, and what makes a customer convert.

  • Coding. You can write code for analysis. The team works in Python.

The salary

We expect to pay from £70,000 to £100,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're hiring a Direct Tax Lead to own our US income tax provision, compliance, and controls, reporting to the Head of Tax. ElevenLabs operates through its US entity and ~9 international entities and is growing fast, which means the provision, the compliance calendar, and the controls around them need a dedicated owner.

This is a hands-on ownership role. The provision and returns are prepared by external providers; you manage those engagements and are accountable for the output. You'll own the quarterly and annual ASC 740 provision (deferreds, valuation allowance, uncertain tax positions, rate rec, footnote disclosures), the US federal and state compliance calendar (returns, extensions, estimated payments), and the technical work underneath it: §174 capitalization, §382 and NOL tracking.

You'll also assist in designing, documenting, and operating controls, and write the memos that support our positions, working directly with our Big 4 advisors and external auditors alongside the Head of Tax.

Requirements

  • Deep ASC 740 expertise at a multinational — provision, deferreds, valuation allowance, uncertain tax positions, rate reconciliation, and footnote disclosure

  • Experience owning a US federal and multistate compliance calendar (returns, extensions, estimates)

  • Working knowledge of US international provisions (NCTI/GILTI, Subpart F, FDDEI, §163(j)) and how they flow into the provision

  • Experience managing Big 4 or equivalent providers and working directly with external auditors

  • Has built or operated SOX controls over tax, or supported a first SOX implementation

  • CPA

Bonus: pre-IPO or first-10-K experience, §174/§41 computation, §382 studies, equity compensation tax (ISOs, NSOs, RSUs), OneSource Tax Provision or similar.

Growth Potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Build and lead the direct tax team as we bring provision and compliance in-house

  • Expand into other strategic initiatives such as M&A, PE mitigation policy, corporate structuring.

  • Broaden into wider tax leadership as our footprint grows

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere on the east coast, New York preferred.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

  • Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

  • Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

  • Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

We’re hiring a Product Manager with deep UX and interaction design expertise to build social experiences around investing and trading at Kraken.


You should be comfortable designing flows yourself, building interactive prototypes, and working through interaction details with designers and engineers. You’ll also own the product decisions: which customer problem to solve, what to ship first, and how to measure whether the experience improved.

 

The opportunity

  • Design complete social journeys. Work through how someone discovers a person, decides to follow them, shares an idea or trade, receives a response, and returns. Connect these interactions into an experience users understand without explanation.

  • Make the interaction details work. Shape navigation, information hierarchy, copy, defaults, gestures, and feedback. Specify what happens when a feed is empty, a post fails, content loads slowly, or someone changes their mind.

  • Prototype before committing to a build. Turn ideas into interactive prototypes that communicate the intended behavior. Explore alternatives, test the uncertain parts, and give engineering clear flows, states, and acceptance criteria.

  • Use psychology to improve participation. Understand why people hesitate to post, seek recognition, follow strangers, or respond to others. Translate those motivations into decisions about audience visibility, prompts, reputation, feedback, and the effort required to contribute.

  • Observe users and fix what gets in their way. Run usability sessions, watch people complete tasks, and combine those observations with funnel data. Identify where people misunderstand the product, lose confidence, or abandon an action.

  • Design for first use and repeated use. Make the experience useful before someone has connections. Keep sharing lightweight during an active trading session, with clear control over what becomes public. Test the twentieth interaction as carefully as the first.

  • Connect design decisions to measurable outcomes. For each significant change, define the expected behavior and how to test it. Track task completion, abandonment, first follows, first contributions, responses, and subsequent retention. Work with data science to evaluate experiments and effects on both contributors and their audiences.

  • Take the experience through launch. Choose a focused initial scope, resolve trade-offs with engineering, review the implementation against the intended design, and use post-launch evidence to decide what to improve next.

 

What you bring

  • Has designed and shipped consumer social experiences. Your portfolio shows your contribution to feeds, profiles, sharing, messaging, discovery, or communities—and how the experience changed after launch.

  • Has strong interaction design craft. You can explain why a flow is structured a particular way, what users will notice first, what they need to understand, and which decisions or steps can be removed.

  • Can build realistic interactive prototypes. You use Figma, code, AI tools, or a combination to make behavior tangible and testable, including transitions, empty states, and failure states.

  • Understands behavior through evidence. You can show where user research challenged your assumptions and changed a design.

  • Can own product outcomes. You can prioritize a problem, define success, interpret funnel and cohort data, and explain whether an experiment produced a meaningful improvement.

  • Understands the context of social finance. You account for how credibility, incentives, reputation, and visibility of financial activity affect what people trust and choose to share.

  • Prioritize the next channels and campaigns to test. Size the upside by market, find the regional platforms and media partners people actually use, then place the biggest bets where customer fit and payback potential are strongest

  • Get tests live with the right team around you. Work shoulder to shoulder with creative strategists, the creative team, and MarTech on the message, format, landing page, tracking, and campaign setup. Own partner conversations, budgets, QA, and the first performance read

  • Make each market feel local. Learn the audience, language, media habits, and rules in each country. Build for that market, then carry what works to the next one

  • Call the result honestly. Look beyond platform ROAS to funded customers, cohort quality, CAC, incrementality, and payback. Change or stop weak tests quickly; give strong ones room to grow

  • Own the winners. When a test clicks, build it into a real channel: develop new creative and campaign types with Creative, strengthen measurement with MarTech, and grow spend as customer value and payback hold

  • Collaborate with paid team members to be best in class growth scale and efficiency. Share tests and learnings openly, help other channel owners, and find ways to make a win in one market work elsewhere

  • You know how paid campaigns actually work on web and app: audiences, creative, conversion tracking, optimization, and the path to a funded customer

About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️

Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in!

We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates.

With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️

Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation.

Your Responsibilities

Before an independent hotelier sees anything related to RoomPriceGenie, they form a feeling. This role owns that feeling — and builds the systems that make it land consistently everywhere.

The Senior Brand Designer & System Lead is two things at once. First: a true brand designer who lives and breathes visual identity and creating unique identities, executes beautiful work personally, and holds a clear instinctive point of view on what makes RoomPriceGenie visually distinctive. Second: an AI systems architect who transforms how design happens inside the business — building the infrastructure and self-serve frameworks that put on-brand creative capability in the hands of every team member, not just designers.

What great looks like: No design bottlenecks, and the brand has never been more vibrant, distinct and alive.

Core Accountabilities

Visual Identity Ownership — Own and evolve the visual identity and full visual system; hold a proactive point of view on brand direction presentable to CMO, CEO, and exec team.

Hero Creative Direction & Development — Develop/commission and direct the highest-stakes assets — campaign visuals, brand films, event creative, exec presentations — leveraging a trusted freelance network as needed. Set the brief, start the creative process, hold the standard, sign off the output.

Social Visual Direction — Set the visual creative direction for LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube in partnership with Content and Demand. Be part of showing what ‘great’ looks like in asset production.

Design AI System Architecture — Own the transformation of how design happens at RPG. Build and evolve the AI-powered creative infrastructure — brand-trained models, prompt libraries, and self-serve templates — that puts on-brand design capability in the hands of every team member. Own quality, fidelity, and adoption. Measure success by what the business creates on-brand.

Brand QA — Act as standard-keeper for all visual output; run fidelity checks across channels, regions, and partners; update models and templates as needed.

Product Brand Partnership — Partner on visual brand development with Product; find ways to ensure the RPG platform and external marketing brand feel connected and aligned — an active partnership, not an advisory one.

What Success Looks Like

Top-level qualitative markers — distinct from the KPI targets above.

  • A hotelier, partner, or candidate who encounters RoomPriceGenie — in any format — feels something. Comfort, intelligence, warmth, confidence. The sense that we genuinely understand them, and we are an industry visionary. That distinct, uplifting, emotive connection is always present.

  • Our brand surprises and delights. There are small, precise moments in our creative — a motion treatment, a colour choice, a typographic detail — where something lands better than expected. These moments accumulate into a brand that feels alive and unmistakably ours.

  • RoomPriceGenie is immediately recognisable and genuinely distinctive in the hospitality-tech market. We look and feel like no one else.

  • The wider business thinks differently about design because of this role. Teams that previously had no design capability now produce on-brand work independently.

  • This person has a clear, articulated point of view on where our brand is going, and presents it credibly to the CMO, CEO, and exec team — proactively, not when asked.

Your Profile

3–5 years in brand design, with a portfolio that demonstrates strategic brand thinking and hands-on creative execution at a high level. This is not a production design role or a marketing design role. We are looking for someone who has owned brand identity — built it, evolved it, and made it unmistakably theirs.

Required Skills

  • Proven track record of working specifically in brand design — not marketing design or design production. Portfolio must show visual identity work: how the brand was shaped, why decisions were made, what changed as a result

  • Demonstrated experience building an AI-driven design system — prompt libraries, brand-trained generative models, AI-powered template frameworks, or visual toolkits used by teams beyond design

  • A strong, trained creative instinct — an instinctive eye for what makes a brand visually distinctive. Can articulate why something works, what is off, and exactly what needs to change

  • Genuinely brand-obsessed — thinks about brand direction constantly, not just when briefed. Has a point of view on where a brand should go before being asked for one

  • Hands-on creative execution — can concept and create beautiful visual work personally, not only direct others. Portfolio shows both strategic direction and craft

  • Experience building visual imaging systems — template frameworks, design tokens, channel adaptation rules — that allow a brand to be rolled out consistently, at scale, and at high quality

  • Genuinely AI-first — uses AI generative tools (CanvaAI, Figma, ElevenLabs, Claude Design etc) as a core part of their creative workflow, not occasionally

  • Experience commissioning and directing freelance creative talent with a clear brief and uncompromisingly high standards

Advantageous Skills

  • Motion and video creative direction experience — concepting and directing short-form brand films, social motion, and event content

  • B2B SaaS, tech, or hospitality-tech brand experience. Strong ICP empathy for hotel owner-operators is a meaningful plus

  • Experience building self-serve Canva or Figma template systems for non-designer teams, including governance and quality control

  • Existing knowledge of or curiosity about the independent hotel market

What We Offer at RoomPriceGenie 💪

At RoomPriceGenie, we don’t just offer jobs; we offer an adventure! 🚀 Join us in an exciting startup atmosphere where you can grow your career while changing the world for tens of thousands of independent hoteliers. 🌍 Our global and diverse team is fueled by passion and a shared mission. We thrive in a culture that’s all about transparency, respect, and making a real impact together.

Here’s what you can expect when you become part of our Genie family:

  • Remote-First Model: Work from (almost!) anywhere. 🌍🧑‍💻 Some roles need you in a specific country or time zone — we'll always flag that in the job ad. And whenever you like, come co-work with us in Mannheim, Berlin, or Sydney. 🏢

  • One Team, One Vision, One Goal: We’re in this together! 🤝 Our Genies are laser-focused on our mission, collaborating to make magic happen. ✨ It’s no wonder we score a stellar 9.3 from our team members! 🌟

  • Epic Team Gatherings: Every year, we bring our global crew together 🌎 for a week of networking, brainstorming, and fun. 🎉 Plus, enjoy regular hangouts in our offices to keep the camaraderie alive.

  • Growth and Development: We’re all about lifelong learning! 📚 Level up your skills with personal and professional development opportunities. You’ll even snag up to three extra days off each year to focus on your growth. 📈

  • 5 Years? 5 Weeks! Stick with us, and we’ll reward your loyalty. After five years, you’ll earn an incredible five weeks of bonus vacation time 🏖️ to recharge and explore the world. 🌍

  • Birthday Celebrations: It’s your day, so take it off! 🎂 Celebrate your birthday the way you want, guilt-free.

  • Flexible Hours: We get it—life happens! ⏰ We offer flexible working hours to help you balance your work and personal life seamlessly.

  • Wellbeing Matters: Your mental health is a top priority. 🧘 Every Genie gets access to Headspace, the leading meditation app, to help you cultivate a happier, healthier, and more zen life. 🌿

  • BetterHelp Support: We also offer BetterHelp, a professional online therapy and counseling platform, giving you additional support whenever you need it.💛🧠
