🌀 The Company

Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action.

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

 

🎯 The Role

We're looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team and help us run, secure, and scale the infrastructure behind the XTM Platform, Filigran's open-source platform for agentic Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM).

Our customer base keeps growing, in more regions and on more providers, and our platform grows with it: our own bare-metal Kubernetes cloud, the major public clouds, sovereign and regulated environments, and on-premises deployments for customers who run our products themselves.

You'll work across the whole platform, from Kubernetes clusters and deployment tooling to observability, security, and on-call, in a team that has made AI agents a core part of how it works.

💼 Your Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate production Kubernetes clusters, on our own bare-metal infrastructure and on public clouds

  • Roll out and operate Filigran products in new regions and on new providers as our SaaS footprint expands

  • Develop and maintain the ways our products get deployed, by us and by our customers: Helm charts (including a major rework of our charts), Ansible automation, CI/CD pipelines, and a virtual appliance for on-premises environments

  • Keep our SaaS instances available and reliable, and continuously improve how we run them: observability, monitoring, capacity planning, incident management, and post-incident reviews

  • Harden the platform and help it meet the requirements of regulated environments (such as FedRAMP and SecNumCloud)

  • Use AI agents throughout your daily work (writing infrastructure code, investigating incidents, drafting runbooks) while staying accountable for everything you review and ship

  • Help design the playground for agents: make our repositories, documentation and guardrails agent-friendly, so other teams can contribute safely, and regularly step back on what works and what needs to improve

  • Take problems from first signal to shipped solution: scope them, propose an approach, and document your decisions so others (humans and agents alike) can build on them

🤝 Who You'll Work With

  • You'll report to the Director of Platform Engineering

  • You'll join a collaborative, non-siloed Platform Engineering team of about fifteen people across three verticals, working closely with our Technical Product Manager and fellow platform engineers, including staff engineers

  • You'll work hand in hand with software development teams and customer support on reliability, scalability and the rollout of new products and features

  • On-call: a shared rotation of around one daytime shift and one night shift every two weeks, plus one weekend every six weeks or so. Night and weekend on-call is compensated.

🧬 Profile We're Looking For

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience as a Platform Engineer, SRE, DevOps or Cloud Engineer

  • Hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production: operating and troubleshooting clusters, not just deploying to them

  • Strong Ansible skills and experience writing and maintaining Helm charts

  • Solid Linux and networking fundamentals

  • Comfortable working on at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP…), or strongly willing to learn

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar) and an observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana…)

  • A security mindset: you think about secrets, access, network exposure and blast radius by default

  • An AI-oriented mindset: you already use AI tools and agents in your work, or you're eager to start, and you review their output with a critical eye

  • Willingness to code: no specific language is required, but you'll read and write scripts and tooling (mostly Python)

  • Comfortable in a remote-first, asynchronous team, with a strong sense of ownership, autonomy and team spirit

  • Full professional proficiency in English

Nice to have

  • Experience with bare-metal or on-premises infrastructure, where you handle networking, storage, and the cluster lifecycle yourself

  • Terraform, especially for cloud infrastructure

  • Infrastructure security experience (hardening, software supply chain, vulnerability management) or a CKS certification

  • Experience with regulated or compliance-heavy environments (FedRAMP, SecNumCloud, ISO 27001…)

  • Operating backing services such as Elasticsearch, RabbitMQ, Redis or S3-compatible storage

  • Hands-on experience designing skills, workflows or guardrails for AI agents

  • Fluent in French

🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job.

We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company, and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation. You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem.

⭐ Be part of something bigger

We believe we do work that matters. Our open-source approach means that work extends beyond Filigran. You’re contributing to technology and ideas that strengthen a global community of defenders and help make cybersecurity more open and collaborative.

💻 Work at the edge of what’s next

We bring together cybersecurity, open source and AI — giving you the opportunity to work with emerging technologies, experiment with new ways of working, and contribute to how they are applied in practice.

Be part of a fast-growing, truly international team — collaborating across Europe, North America, APJ and beyond, with the flexibility of a remote-first environment. As we grow, you’ll have opportunities to expand your scope, take ownership, learn quickly and grow with us.

We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The Role

Heidi sits in an unusual position. We lead a category being built for the first time. Hundreds of thousands of clinicians found us on their own, started using the product for free, and told a colleague. The market is open, and we're in the privileged position of clinicians already liking the product. Your job is to turn those smaller-scale use cases into enterprise deals.

You're the first line to Heidi in France. Inbound demand connects you with cabinets, maisons de santé, and hospital groups already using us, and you decide whether to qualify each one in, out, or close it yourself. Where the signals run thin, you build the outbound.

For most clinicians, you'll be the first person from Heidi they ever speak to. You'll both triage inbound to Account Executives where needed and close your own deals from day one, because we want people as close to the frontline as possible. You'll build a network across French healthcare that outlasts the role.

What you’ll do

  • Work the inbound queue and the warm product signals across France. Your day goes to clinicians and cabinets already using Heidi, where the product tells you who's outgrown the free version.

  • Build outbound where the signals are thin: pick the practice groups, maisons de santé and hospital groups worth going after and work them in French.

  • Research the accounts behind those signals, work out who else in the cabinet or hospital group needs to be in the conversation, and build the case for each one.

  • Reach the people the signals point to, across calls, email and social, while the interest is still fresh.

  • Book demos and meetings for your AEs with enough context that nothing is lost in the handoff.

  • Own SMB deals end to end, from first conversation through to closed.

  • Keep HubSpot accurate, keep the pipeline moving and hit your qualified-lead number every month.

  • Partner with AEs, Marketing, Product, Operations and Customer Success so what you promise on the call matches what clinicians get, and so the French-language product and collateral keep up with what you hear.

  • Track what's shifting in French healthcare (regulation, the practice and hospital groups, Assurance Maladie and the mutuelles, the competitive set) and tell the team what you're hearing on the phones.

What you'll need

  • Native or fluent French, and English that allows you to work in a global team.

  • You've worked somewhere with a high bar, whether that's tech, sales, creative, banking, consulting, or PE/VC. We care more about what you've achieved than your time in a sales role.

  • You care about what we do. You'd rather learn how the product works than memorise a pitch.

  • You can hold a conversation with anyone and get to the point of it fast. Clinicians have extremely busy schedules, so you need to respect that and still get the meeting.

  • Knowing how French healthcare buys (who decides in a cabinet, a maison de santé or a hospital group, and who pays) is a head start. If you don't know it yet, you're the type who'd learn it in your first weeks.

  • Organised and self-running. You run your own list, your own day and your own follow-ups without being chased.

  • Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping or side projects.

  • You default to building over requesting.

  • You're confident in your thinking and open to being wrong. At Heidi, great ideas win regardless of who surfaces them.

Attitude is more important than experience, so if you are a hungry, competitive and highly motivated operator who has a knack for problem-solving and building relationships, we want to hear from you.

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

We take care of you.

We chose to open-source our benefits hub, if you care to take a peek.

Compensation: €55K – €70K • + OTE

We’re building the risk infrastructure for our traditional-financing trading groups from the ground up, and we’re looking for a Senior Quantitative Risk Manager to help shape it. You’ll report to the Head of Risk, work closely with portfolio managers and engineers.

Werde Teil eines ambitionierten und zukunftsorientierten Teams, das die Beauty-Branche nachhaltig verändert!

Deine Aufgaben

  • Dein Tag, deine Mission: Du planst deine Woche flexibel und zielgerichtet – für maximalen Erfolg.

  • Mitreißende Produkt-Demos: Du bringst unsere Software zum Leben und zeigst, wie sie den Alltag deiner Kund:innen einfacher und erfolgreicher macht.

  • Kund:innen gewinnen: Du überzeugst potenzielle Kund:innen mit Know-how – ob bei der Kaltakquise am Telefon, vor Ort oder spontan beim Walk-In.

  • Vertriebsleidenschaft: Begeisterung für den Vertrieb und Freude am Kontakt mit Menschen – Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Außendienst und der Akquise neuer Kund:innen.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Attraktive Vergütung: Fixum plus ungedeckelter Bonus – dein Erfolg zahlt sich aus!

  • Firmenwagen: Immer mobil, ob Kundentermin oder Wochenende.

Wir wachsen schnell und suchen dich - werde Teil unseres Teams 🏆

Wie gehts weiter:

Nach Eingang deiner Bewerbung werden wir uns schnellstmöglich bei Dir melden. Im weiteren Prozess lernst du unser Recruiting-Team, die Team Leads und den Regional Manager deiner Region kennen.

Salonkee fördert Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung oder Identität.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a Software Engineer, Mission Execution, you'll build the software backbone that carries mission plans from the planner to the field. You'll own the infrastructure that executes missions on autonomous robots and multi-agent systems. You'll work closely with the Mission Planning engineer, simulation engineers and product teams to make sure our systems are reliable, testable, and predictable in live operations.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build the mission execution infrastructure that turns planned missions into reliable, real-time behavior across fleets of autonomous systems.

  • Develop scalable backend services and APIs for mission guidance, orchestration, agents communication, and execution.

  • Set and defend a high quality bar: CI/CD pipelines, testing, code review standards, observability, and release discipline.

  • Write production-grade C++ and Python that runs in real-time and resource-constrained environments.

  • Partner with Mission Planning, and product teams to ensure algorithms are integrated cleanly, tested thoroughly, and deployable in the field.

  • Analyze logs and telemetry from tests and live operations to find failure modes and drive systemic fixes.

Candidate Requirements

  • Education: M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Robotics, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Technical skills: Strong coding in C++ and Python, with solid software engineering fundamentals (system design, concurrency, testing, debugging).

  • Experience building and shipping production software: Ideally with distributed or real-time systems.

  • Nice to have: Experience in robotics, embedded software, or video game development (game engines, simulation, deterministic replay, tooling). Experience in aerospace or defense. Familiarity with simulation frameworks.

  • Mindset: Strong communication skills, Rigor, ownership, and a strong instinct for quality.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Nice to have

This is Cradle

Proteins are the molecular machines of life, used for many therapeutic, diagnostic, chemical, agricultural and food applications. Designing and optimizing proteins takes a lot of expert knowledge and manual effort, through the use of custom computational and biological tools.

Machine learning is revolutionizing this space, by enabling high-fidelity protein models. At Cradle, we offer a software platform for AI-guided discovery and optimization of proteins, so that biologists can design proteins faster and at scale. We are already used by clients across biopharma, biotech, agri-tech, food-tech, and academia.

We're an experienced team of just under 100 people. We've built many successful products before and have enough funding for multiple years of runway. We are distributed across three offices in Amsterdam, Boston, and Zurich, alongside a few remote colleagues.

We offer our employees a very competitive salary, a generous equity stake in the company and a wide range of benefits and career progression opportunities.

The Role

As Executive Assistant at Cradle, you'll keep two of our founding executives moving. Between customer visits, investor meetings, hiring and travel across Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, there's a lot to keep track of, and your job is to make sure nothing gets dropped. You'll own their calendars, inboxes and travel, and take care of the personal admin that would otherwise eat into their time. This role suits someone who likes being trusted with the whole picture, professional and personal, and treats both with the same care.

Responsibilities

  • Run two calendars as one system: Protect focus time, balance competing priorities across time zones, and decide what deserves a meeting and what can be an email.

  • Own the inbox front line: Triage, draft and reply on their behalf to customers, investors, candidates and the team, so the important things surface and the rest gets handled.

  • Plan travel end to end: Customer visits, conferences and trips between Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, from flights and hotels to the meeting room and dinner booking on the other side.

  • Take care of personal and life admin: Appointments, household logistics, official paperwork, bills and renewals, handled so none of it lands on their desks.

  • Prepare every important meeting: Make sure briefs and context are ready beforehand, and follow up on decisions and action items afterwards.

  • Make recurring admin disappear: Automate repeated processes so they mostly run themselves.

Requirements

The best people we've hired didn't match a checklist. Below is a list of what matters most for this role. If you bring most of it and are curious about the rest, we'd love to hear from you:

  • 4+ years supporting senior executives, ideally more than one at a time

  • Sharp judgment about what's urgent, what can wait and what never needs to reach the exec

  • Clear, polished written English

  • You spot the next problem before anyone asks and fix it

  • Experience handling personal admin alongside the professional side, with the discretion that comes with it

  • Organised and dependable without needing a rigid structure; at a ~90-person company you'll often build the process yourself

  • At home in Google Workspace and quick to pick up new software tools

Nice to Haves

These aren't requirements, but they'd give you a head start:

  • German fluency would be idea to would make local appointments, paperwork and authorities much easier

  • Experience in a startup or scale-up environment

  • Familiarity with Swiss administrative procedures (permits, insurance, tax paperwork, relocations)

  • Experience with task tools like Todoist, Notion or Linear

Our commitment to inclusive hiring

Cradle evaluates all candidates based on merit, regardless of sex, gender, ethnicity, socio-economic background, or any other aspect of identity. We maintain zero tolerance for discrimination and actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

AI disclosure

Cradle uses an applicant tracking system that includes basic AI-assisted features which may generate scores or rankings based on how applications match a job description. These outputs are not used to make or meaningfully influence hiring decisions — all candidates are evaluated through a thorough, human-led review by our recruiting team.

A notice about recruitment scams

Please be aware that scammers are posing as us in order to get your personal details or money. We only communicate via @cradle.bio email addresses, we only make job offers after having met you in person at our office in Zurich or Amsterdam, and we never ask you to pay for anything during the interview process.

📍Zürich, Switzerland (on-site, remote not possible)

Loki Robotics' mission is to 10x the physical services economy through robotics and physical AI. We build, deploy and operate expert robots with unique capabilities to automate commercial facility services at scale. We believe emergent capabilities in physical AI are unlocked by taking a straight shot to useful, performant robots deployed in the real world. We're a tight team that takes initiative, operates with agency, and genuinely cares about doing outstanding work.

Your role

The largest facility services providers in the world are adopting physical AI with us. As GTM lead, you’ll be turning that demand into the commercial engine behind Loki’s growth. You’ll run enterprise sales, close and grow the biggest accounts, and build the team and process around it to scale.

What you will be doing

  • Work a pipeline of facility services providers and operators that is larger than our current team can serve, and decide where to focus

  • Close enterprise contracts yourself, from first meeting to signature

  • Grow accounts from a first deployment to rollouts across customers’ entire portfolio

  • Build Loki’s sales engine: qualification, demos, closing, and handover to deployment operations

  • Work closely with product and engineering to bring customer insights back to product development

  • Hire and lead the sales, account management and customer success teams as the engine scales

What you should have

  • 5+ years of experience in B2B sales or business development, at least 3 of them closing deals yourself

  • You’ve been one of the first commercial hires at an early-stage company and helped take it from founder-led sales to a team that sells independently

  • You've sold into large enterprises with multi-stakeholder deals, where the buyers are across operations, procurement and the C-suite

  • You come from a company selling physical products, hardware, automation or industrial technology into operations-heavy industries; robotics or facility services is a strong plus

  • You can operate without a playbook, existing sales team or a defined territory

  • Excellent communication in English; German, Italian or French is a plus

What we offer

  • Ownership of Loki’s commercial strategy and execution

  • Close partnership with the founders/leadership team

  • Flat-hierarchy, quick decision making and a responsibility in executing Loki's global expansion

Don't worry if you don't hit every checkmark. We value people who learn fast and care about building great products. If Loki excites you and you believe you can help us scale, just give it a go and apply.

Research Engineer, Manipulation Data & Teleoperation — Zurich

This role owns the data generation layer of Sereact's VLA stack: teleoperation systems and data collection infrastructure that feed Cortex, built from our Zurich research hub.

About Sereact

Sereact is a Series B embodied-AI company. Cortex, our VLA model, is deployed in live warehouse robotic cells across the EU and US. Zurich is our newest research hub, focused on the manipulation and control problems that sit underneath Cortex.

The role

This is a Research Engineer position. It is scoped to the data generation layer of the VLA stack: teleoperation hardware and software, retargeting pipelines that map human demonstrations onto robot hands, and the data collection infrastructure that feeds Cortex. It requires building the systems that produce the data those models train on, and working closely with the training team on what that data needs to look like.

What you'll do

  • Build and operate teleoperation systems for dexterous manipulation, including retargeting algorithms that map human hand and arm motion onto robot end-effectors

  • Design and maintain scalable, UMI-style data collection hardware and software that other engineers at Sereact rely on

  • Benchmark control and retargeting approaches using rigorous, human-factors-informed methodology

  • Instrument and support the physical robots deployed in the Zurich hub, including day-to-day work on the control stack

  • Work with the model-training team to define what data they need and close the loop on data quality

  • Build tooling or infrastructure outside your immediate brief when it unblocks the wider team

What you'll bring

  • MSc (or equivalent, in progress) in robotics, mechanical engineering, or a closely related field, with a thesis or capstone project on manipulation, teleoperation, or retargeting

  • Hands-on experience building a data collection device or system for robot learning (UMI or a comparable system), not just operating one someone else built

  • Working knowledge of retargeting algorithms for mapping human input onto robot hands or end-effectors

  • 1 to 2 years of combined research, internship, or industry experience in robotics, mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline

  • Software and systems engineering skills strong enough to build and maintain infrastructure other engineers rely on, not only research-grade prototypes

  • Comfortable working as an individual contributor in a small, still-forming team

Nice to have

  • A conference submission on manipulation, teleoperation, or retargeting where the candidate is an author (an MSc thesis submitted to a venue like CoRL counts; supervising a student team whose own work was later published does not)

  • Teaching or TA experience in a robotics course

  • Some exposure to large-model training, even without an independent training record

  • A concrete example of building something outside the formal role brief because the team needed it

Location:

Zurich Area, Switzerland:

  • This role is based in our Zurich office, offering a vibrant ecosystem for robotics and AI.

What We Offer:

  • Free meals at the workplace.

  • Flexible working hours and the option to work from home when needed.

  • Direct collaboration with founders and world-leading AI experts.

  • Access to large-scale compute clusters and proprietary robotic datasets.

  • A key role in shaping the future of embodied AI.

  • Competitive compensation and a relocation package for the Zurich area

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

ProcessOS is a new kind of Camunda product: business processes described in natural language, generated as executable BPMN workflows, and improved autonomously from production data. We’re hiring the first cohort of Forward Deployed Engineers to bring it into production at enterprise customers. You’ll own the deployment journey from first process file to a working, improving system, and hand off a functioning capability to the customer’s team. The code you write and the patterns you discover feed directly back into how ProcessOS is built. This is a rare opportunity to shape a product, a function, and a field practice from day one.


You’ll work end‑to‑end across Java services and React interfaces, collaborating closely with a talented global team to measure, improve, and scale performance and fault tolerance in real-world distributed systems.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  •  Deploy and prove. Own the journey from first process file to production workflow. At 90 days: at least one workflow running, the improvement loop active, and measurable fitness gains the customer can see. At 12 months: 3–5 customers with viable deployments.

  • Drive organizational adoption. Work across technical and business stakeholders to build understanding and trust, turning early deployments into lasting customer capability.

  • Work at depth technically. Configure and run Camunda clusters locally and in cloud environments. Debug integration failures. Build custom agents where platform defaults don’t fit. Write connector logic that gets legacy enterprise systems talking to ProcessOS.

  • Build the playbook. There is no deployment template yet. Document what good looks like as you discover it, and make the next implementation faster.

  • Feed the product. Custom agents you write get contributed back. Integration patterns get codified. Production bugs you find, you often fix. Your field work is a direct input to ProcessOS.

  • Hand off deliberately. Leave customers with a team that can operate independently, is trained on the platform, and acts on improvement results without you.

What You Will Bring to the Role

Must Haves:

  • Enterprise production experience: you’ve shipped something inside a large organization and stayed to see it operate. You know why governance and resilience matter at scale.

  • Technical depth: You can debug an integration failure, write a custom agent against a legacy API, stand up a Camunda cluster from scratch, and explain generated BPMN to both engineers and business leads.

  • Stakeholder communication: you work effectively across engineering, architecture, and business leadership and adapt how you communicate without losing precision.

  • Practical AI experience: you’ve used AI to solve real problems in production – not just experimented. You understand context management, prompt engineering, agent testing, and integration tradeoffs.

  • Comfort with ambiguity: you make sound judgment calls without a playbook and document what you learn.

  • Occasional travel may be required

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience in a customer-facing engineering or professional services role.

  • Familiarity with regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or insurance

  • Production experience with agentic systems or AI-integrated workflows.

  • Contributions to a shared platform or open source project that others built on.

We are looking for a motivated and committed professional who is ready to actively grow with us, combining in-depth technical knowledge with a pronounced cooperative spirit.

SAEKI - Manufacturing at software speed

Europe's defense industrial base cannot respond at the speed modern conflict requires. Legacy suppliers operate on month-long timelines. Tribal knowledge is retiring. Supply chains are fragile. SAEKI is building the operating system for autonomous factories — the infrastructure that lets Europe manufacture mission-critical components at software speed.

Every part we make generates data, decisions, and handoffs. Your job is to capture that knowledge, automate the work around it, and remove whatever slows production down. When a critical defense program needs parts by next week, the systems you build are why we can deliver.


The Role

As a Full-Stack Software Engineer on our manufacturing intelligence team, you'll work wherever the leverage is highest. One week that means turning an operator's spreadsheet into a proper workflow; the next it means wiring machine data into scheduling, or cutting a manual quoting step out of the order flow.


You'll own problems end to end across our customer portal, Enterprise Resource Planning / Manufacturing Execution System, and the data layer connecting them to the shop floor. 


Based at our HQ at “The Circle” (Zurich airport), your work will span:

  • Manufacturing Intelligence: Capturing process, machine, and quality data so knowledge lives in systems instead of in people's heads.

  • Automation: Replacing manual steps in quoting, planning, scheduling, and documentation with software that runs on its own.

  • Production Acceleration: Finding the bottlenecks between CAD/CAM data submission and shipped parts.

  • Tools for People: Building interfaces that make life easier for operators, engineers, and customers, whether that's a work instruction screen, a dashboard, or a self-service portal.


Importantly, you do not need prior experience in the manufacturing domain. We value a high level of curiosity and autonomy to find and solve problems.


What We're Looking For

  • Experience: 3+ years as a software engineer with proven experience in shipping code to production, across backend and frontend

  • Broad Technical Range: Experience in systems design, architecture and implementation. In general, you don’t shy away from new technologies and pick up whatever the problem requires. Our current tech stack is: Rust, PostgreSQL, React,  Python, AWS.

  • End-to-End Ownership: From talking to the user, to schema, to API, to UI, to rollout. You don't hand off "the other half."

  • Industrial Grit: Comfortable spending time on the shop floor in Germany to understand how work actually happens and how your software interacts with precision machinery.

  • Autonomy: You are comfortable with diving into new topics, coming up with solutions and driving their implementation

  • Bonus points: Knowledge of manufacturing and how factories operate, basic understanding of the Manufacturing Automation Pyramid

  • On-site: Ability to work in person at our HQ in Zurich, Switzerland.


What we're not looking for

  • Engineers who only work on frontend or only work on backend. You must be comfortable across the full stack.

  • People who need detailed specs before they start building. You'll work directly with users and define the solution yourself.

  • Developers who ship code and move on. You own the outcome — not just the PR.

  • Engineers who are uncomfortable with ambiguity or rapidly changing priorities.


What we offer

  • Mission: Rebuild the industrial sovereignty of Europe. Your work directly enables the production of mission-critical hardware for defense and space

  • Total Ownership: High-stakes autonomy in your domain. You own both the problems and the solutions, and have the authority to execute.

  • The Environment: You are building solutions to accelerate production in a 5,000 m² state-of-the-art facility featuring 5-axis CNCs, industrial robots, and industrial plastic and metal 3D printers. Your work affects production of physical parts from day one.

  • The Team: Growing team of experienced software engineers, who value an open feedback culture. You may (and are expected to) challenge the status quo, prior decisions and drive SAEKI’s way forward.

  • Compensation: Competitive salary + meaningful equity.

  • Location: Zurich HQ with occasional travel to Factory ONE in Munich, Germany


Apply

data.description:
SAEKI - Manufacturing at software speed

Europe's defense industrial base cannot respond at the speed modern conflict requires. Legacy suppliers operate on month-long timelines. Tribal knowledge is retiring. Supply chains are fragile. SAEKI is building the operating system for autonomous factories - the infrastructure that lets Europe manufacture mission-critical components at software speed.


The Role

As a Computational Geometry Engineer, you own the geometry core of our Manufacturing Intelligence stack - the engine that takes an arbitrary customer CAD model and reasons about how to build it, and then proves that we built it right.
You own the code that runs in the factory.


What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years building geometry-heavy software in production - CAD/CAM, geometry kernels, feature recognition, CAE/simulation preparation, metrology, or comparable.
  • B-rep and Mesh Depth. You think natively in topology and NURBS. Feature recognition, defeaturing, robust booleans, offsetting, surface/surface intersection, healing and repair. You know exactly why floating-point robustness destroys naive implementations - and what to do about it. You have had the opportunity to delve into complex CAD models and are able to assess their quality in both quantitative and qualitative terms (gaps in edge, spikes in loops, tiny elements, twisted surfaces...) and ultimately predict which types of processing might be challenged.
  • Kernel Fluency. Hands-on with a geometry kernel - Parasolid, OpenCASCADE, ACIS, or equivalent - and the judgment to know which parts can be developed in-house in order to retain full control and IP rights, and which parts too complex (e.g. advanced solvers) should be integrated as 3rd parties. Comfortable with mesh and point-cloud processing (libigl, Open3D, CGAL, PCL) alongside solid modelling.You know well STEP file format and about integration into collaboration & interoperability processes.
  • Technical Excellence. Strong command of modern C++ (17+), plus Python for rapid iteration. Rust is welcome. You write and test performant code. 
  • Manufacturing Instinct. Some knowledge of fabrication techniques-casting, stamping, composites, and additive manufacturing-alongside toolsets for evaluating design manufacturability, risk profiles, quality standards, and cost factors.
  • End-to-End Ownership. Algorithm design through to a shipped, tested, maintained service.
  • First Principles Thinker. You reason by physics and mathematics, not analogy. When an algorithm fails on a real part, you know whether the bug is in the code, the model, or the assumption.
  • Industrial Grit. You want to stand next to the machine in Germany and watch your output run. The feedback loop between your code and cutting metal is the point.
  • Maniacal Urgency. Speed is our only edge. You thrive in the "chaos-to-order" phase of a startup.
  • On-site: Ability to work in person at our HQ in Zurich, Switzerland.


What we're not looking for

  • Researchers who want to publish and hand off. You ship.
  • CAD users. This is a role for people who build the tools, not drive them.
  • Engineers who need a clean spec. The problem is defined by the part, the machine, and the customer - you'll go find it.
  • People who treat "it works on the test model" as done. Real customer CAD is broken, degenerate, and adversarial. That is the job.
  • Engineers who are uncomfortable with ambiguity or rapidly changing priorities.


What we offer

  • Mission: Rebuild the industrial sovereignty of the West. Your work directly enables production of mission-critical hardware for defense and space.
  • Total Ownership: High-stakes autonomy in your domain. You own both the problems and the solutions - and have the authority to execute.
  • The Environment: Access to a 8,000 m² state-of-the-art facility featuring 5-axis CNCs, industrial robots, and industrial 3D printers. Your algorithms run on real hardware from day one.
  • The Team: "Special Forces" model. Everyone senior, everyone ships. No politics, no bureaucracy. Direct feedback, high standards.
  • Compensation: Competitive salary + meaningful equity.
  • Location: Zurich HQ, with occasional time at Factory ONE in Munich.


Apply

Resume: Focus on geometry systems you've built and owned.
GitHub/Portfolio: Show us the hard problem you solved - code, papers, or parts that came off a machine because of you.
Cover letter: Why this mission? Why now? What would you build first?

Your Impact

We are looking for a senior, hands-on Dynamics 365 & Power Platform Technical Lead to own the technical development, integration, and lifecycle management of our Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform environment.
The role covers Dynamics 365 Sales, Dynamics 365 Customer Service, and Dynamics 365 Marketing, together with Microsoft Dataverse, Power Apps, Power Automate, platform integrations, and related Azure services.
You will translate business requirements into robust technical solutions and determine when to use standard platform capabilities, configuration, low-code development, or custom code. The role combines hands-on platform development with technical leadership, solution governance, and long-term ownership.
This is primarily a Dynamics 365 and Power Platform role. Strong professional software development experience with C#/.NET, React, and TypeScript is a valuable asset where requirements justify custom extensions, components, services, or integrations.
You will work closely with business process owners across customer-facing teams, Technical Customer Support, Marketing, Data Engineering, and Corporate IT.
 
Your Contribution:

  • Own the platform: Set the technical direction for Dynamics 365 and Power Platform, including architecture, environments, standards, and lifecycle management.
  • Deliver solutions: Design, configure, develop, test, deploy, and maintain solutions across Dynamics 365, Dataverse, Power Apps, and Power Automate.
  • Extend where needed: Develop Dataverse plug-ins, custom APIs, business logic, client-side extensions, and Power Apps Component Framework components when standard or low-code capabilities are insufficient.
  • Integrate enterprise systems: Design and maintain secure, reliable integrations between Dynamics 365, ERP, Microsoft 365, Azure, and other business systems.
  • Ensure engineering quality: Establish appropriate practices for source control, testing, CI/CD, deployment, monitoring, documentation, security, and technical debt management.
  • Lead technical delivery: Translate business requirements into sound solution designs, guide implementation partners, resolve complex technical issues, and ensure delivered solutions meet agreed standards.


Role Boundaries and Collaboration

The Senior Dynamics 365 & Power Platform Technical Lead is accountable for:

  • Technical architecture and solution design across Dynamics 365 and Power Platform.
  • Dataverse application models, business logic, security configuration, and extensions.
  • Platform integrations, environments, releases, and application lifecycle management.
  • Technical standards, solution quality, and coordination of technical delivery.
Business process owners are accountable for:
  • Business processes, priorities, and functional requirements.
  • Business policies and decision-making.
  • User adoption and expected business outcomes.
  • Acceptance of process and solution changes.
Data Engineering is accountable for:
  • Microsoft Fabric lakehouses and data pipelines.
  • Analytical data models and governed data products.
  • Power BI platform delivery and analytical reporting.
These roles collaborate on data contracts, data quality, lineage, security, and the reliable transfer of Dynamics 365 data into the analytical data platform.


Your Background

  • Strong hands-on experience developing and maintaining Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform solutions, ideally including Dynamics 365 Sales and Customer Service.
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Dataverse, including data models, security roles, business logic, solutions, environments, and model-driven applications.
  • Practical experience with Power Apps and Power Automate beyond basic configuration or citizen-development scenarios.
  • Experience extending Dynamics 365 and Dataverse using C# plug-ins, custom APIs, and JavaScript/TypeScript client-side extensions.
  • Experience with REST/OData, the Dataverse Web API, authentication, error handling, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Practical experience with Power Platform ALM, Git-based source control, CI/CD, testing, and controlled deployment across environments.
  • Sound understanding of enterprise application security, reliability, maintainability, and supportability.
  • Ability to translate business workflows into pragmatic technical solutions and make sound trade-offs between standard functionality, low-code development, and custom code.
  • Ability to provide technical guidance, review solution designs and code, and work effectively with business stakeholders, technical teams, and implementation partners
  • Eligibility to work in Switzerland
Strong plus / nice-to-have
  • Professional software development experience with C#/.NET, including production applications, backend services, APIs, or integration components.
  • Experience with React and TypeScript, particularly for custom user experiences or Power Apps Component Framework components.
  • Experience designing, testing, deploying, and maintaining custom software beyond Dynamics 365 and low-code solutions.
  • Experience with Azure integration services such as Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Key Vault, or Application Insights.
  • Practical experience with Dynamics 365 Marketing (Customer Insights – Journeys).
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Fabric and Power BI sufficient to collaborate effectively on data integration and reporting requirements.
  • Experience with Power Platform governance or enterprise-scale environment and solution management.
  • Familiarity with Copilot Studio or AI-enabled capabilities within Dynamics 365 and Power Platform.
  • Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate (PL-400), or comparable Microsoft Learn training supported by relevant practical experience.
Working style and profile
  • Combines deep Dynamics 365 and Power Platform expertise with pragmatic software engineering judgment.
  • Takes hands-on ownership while providing clear technical direction and standards.
  • Prefers maintainable, standard-first solutions and uses customization deliberately where it creates clear value.
  • Balances delivery speed with security, reliability, supportability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Communicates technical trade-offs clearly and builds alignment across business and technical stakeholders.
  • Works collaboratively, challenges unnecessary complexity constructively, and takes responsibility through the full solution lifecycle.


What We Offer

  • Work with a team of experienced IT professionals using modern hybrid cloud infrastructure.
  • Structured onboarding and ongoing internal and external training.
  • Attractive vacation entitlement.
  • Flexible working arrangements with home office allowance.
  • Comprehensive pension plans that reflect individual seniority.
  • Contributions to public transportation.
  • Regular team events.
  • FELFEL with healthy food and beverages.

This position is a one year maternity cover, with an expected start date of 1 November 2026. For the right candidate, the start date can be negotiated, and there is a possibility of extending the position beyond the initial one-year period.

About Teton

Our vision is to be the indispensable AI companion for care staff, transforming patient care, and ultimately operations and delivery across the entire healthcare industry.

Our product is an AI-powered companion for care staff, leveraging proprietary computer vision technology to alleviate the administrative inefficiencies and observational tasks that overburden care professionals, enabling them to provide better patient care.

Through a combination of in-room hardware, AI and desktop and mobile applications, Teton enhances workflow optimization, decision-making, and patient outcomes, creating a seamless healthcare experience for both patients and providers. Our solution provides unprecedented access to real-time data insights, creating a digital twin of patient states and care delivery that empowers healthcare providers with actionable intelligence for optimal decision-making.

Responsibilities:

You will be responsible for the customer journey from the moment the contract is signed through site planning, implementation, onboarding, and expansion. Key responsibilities include:

  • Coordinating the successful installation of Teton’s hardware on-site, working with the technical project manager, customer stakeholders like IT, Estate planning, and care staff to create an excellent customer experience.

  • Develop strong relationships with front-line customers through empathy and your ability to solve problems, which may mean joining a night shift and traveling around in Jutland.

  • Partner with our product and engineering teams to successfully calibrate and troubleshoot.

  • Provide excellent customer service, resolving issues promptly and professionally.

  • Partner with our business development teams to run successful QBRs, identifying and capitalising on expansion opportunities.

  • Contribute to our goal of continually enhancing our product and service based on customer feedback and needs.

Qualifications:

  • Experience as a Customer Success Manager in SaaS or other tech enabled services.

  • You have a background in the care sector, for example in elderly care, or a social science background, for example in anthropology or sociology.

  • You are proactive, passionate, and like to work in a dynamic team.

  • You enjoy visiting customers regularly and are committed to understanding their needs.

  • You are adept at onboarding and training new users.

  • You’re excited about being part of a team that implements solutions and initiates new customer relationships.

  • You’re great at structuring and planning.

  • You are curious and have an outgoing profile with excellent interpersonal skills.

  • You are based in Jutland and are comfortable travelling to customers. Some customer visits may require overnight stays.

  • Must have a valid drivers license.

  • Must speak Danish fluently, and be proficient in English.

What is working at Teton like?

We are a growing team of extremely hard working and talented people. The learning curves are steep and expanding one’s skill set is encouraged. It’s a workplace where you get your hands dirty and learn a lot. If you are looking for the vibe of large corporations, Teton might not be the place for you, but if you like to build products and strive to be the best in your field, we believe that Teton is a place where you will thrive.

We’re looking for a teammate

We are looking for people who believe in our long-term vision and value ownership and entrepreneurship rather than just another 9-5 job.

With us you will have an opportunity to truly make an impact on the world with the outcomes of your work. So, if you are looking for a ride not just a job – jump on board 😊

US Marketing Lead

Location: United States

Reports to: VP of Marketing

Employment type: Full-time

About Teton

Teton is building the autonomous operating system for care. Our technology gives senior living and care teams greater visibility into resident wellbeing, movement, sleep, and care delivery, helping them respond faster, work more efficiently, and provide more personalized care.

We are growing quickly across the United States and are looking for a US Marketing Lead to own our regional marketing strategy and execution.

The Role

The US Marketing Lead will be the territory owner for Teton’s growth and brand presence in the United States.

You will translate Teton’s global positioning and company priorities into a focused US marketing plan that creates demand, strengthens our reputation, and helps the sales team win. This is a hands-on role for someone who can set the regional strategy, build campaigns, produce sales materials, support events, coordinate PR, and measure what is working.

You will work closely with US Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing, Events, Growth, and external partners. You will report to the VP of Marketing and serve as the primary marketing partner for the US commercial team.

What You’ll Own

US Marketing Strategy

  • Develop and execute the US marketing plan in alignment with company revenue goals and global marketing priorities.

  • Identify the audiences, markets, partnerships, and channels most likely to drive growth.

  • Adapt Teton’s global campaigns and positioning for the US senior living and care market.

  • Maintain a clear regional campaign calendar, budget, and set of priorities.

  • Bring insights from customers, prospects, competitors, and the market back into the broader marketing organization.

Demand Generation and Campaigns

  • Partner with Growth Lead to build and run integrated campaigns across email, paid media, content, webinars, events, partnerships, and other relevant channels.

  • Create campaigns around Teton’s most important customer problems and product capabilities.

  • Own regional email strategy, segmentation, nurture programs, and campaign follow-up.

  • Work with Growth to improve lead generation, conversion, and account engagement.

  • Develop targeted programs for priority accounts, operator groups, and strategic market segments.

  • Ensure leads are properly captured, routed, followed up on, and measured in HubSpot.

Sales Enablement

  • Serve as the primary marketing partner to the US sales organization.

  • Develop and maintain US-specific sales decks, case studies, one-pagers, proposals, follow-up materials, and campaign assets.

  • Translate product capabilities into clear operational and commercial value for senior living operators.

  • Equip sales with the proof points, customer stories, and market insights needed to move opportunities forward.

  • Support account-based campaigns for strategic prospects and active opportunities.

  • Gather regular feedback from Sales and Customer Success to identify gaps in messaging, content, and enablement.

Events, Webinars, and Partnerships

  • Partner with the Events lead to determine which US conferences, webinars, executive gatherings, and field programs deserve investment.

  • Build pre-event, on-site, and post-event campaigns that generate meetings and measurable pipeline.

  • Support speaker submissions, presentations, sponsorships, customer participation, and event messaging.

  • Develop regional partnerships with associations, media organizations, technology partners, and other industry stakeholders.

  • Ensure events are connected to broader campaigns rather than treated as standalone activities.

Content, Customer Stories, and PR

  • Identify strong US customer stories and work with Customer Success to turn them into case studies, testimonials, videos, and campaign assets.

  • Develop content that reflects the priorities and language of US senior living operators.

  • Work with internal subject-matter experts to produce thought leadership, educational content, reports, and webinars.

  • Coordinate with Teton’s PR partners on announcements, contributed articles, awards, speaking opportunities, and media relationships.

  • Help establish Teton and its leadership as credible voices in the US senior living market.

Product Positioning and Market Intelligence

  • Localize global product positioning for US audiences while maintaining consistency with Teton’s overall narrative.

  • Develop messaging for different US customer segments, buyer roles, and stages of the sales process.

  • Monitor competitors, category trends, customer needs, and changes in the senior living market.

  • Partner with Product Marketing and Product to support launches and communicate new capabilities effectively.

  • Ensure US market feedback is reflected in future campaigns, content, and product messaging.

Measurement and Reporting

  • Define regional goals and report on campaign performance, lead generation, pipeline contribution, event results, and channel effectiveness.

  • Maintain clear dashboards and regular updates for Marketing and US commercial leadership.

  • Use performance data to improve targeting, messaging, campaign investment, and sales follow-up.

  • Establish a consistent process for evaluating what is working, what is not, and where the team should focus next.

What Success Looks Like

In your first year, you will have:

  • Established a clear and credible US marketing strategy tied to Teton’s commercial goals.

  • Built a consistent campaign engine that generates qualified demand and supports pipeline growth.

  • Improved the quality and consistency of US sales enablement.

  • Created a repeatable approach to US events, webinars, partnerships, and account-based programs.

  • Expanded Teton’s library of US customer proof points and case studies.

  • Increased Teton’s visibility and credibility with senior living operators and industry stakeholders.

  • Created transparent reporting that shows how US marketing contributes to revenue.

What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years of B2B marketing experience, ideally in healthcare technology, senior living, or enterprise software industry.

  • Experience owning a regional, vertical, or business-unit marketing strategy.

  • A track record of building integrated campaigns that contribute to pipeline and revenue.

  • Strong sales enablement experience and the ability to work closely with enterprise sales teams.

  • Experience with events, content, email marketing, webinars, account-based marketing, and demand generation.

  • Excellent writing, editing, messaging, and presentation skills.

  • Strong project-management skills and the ability to move between strategy and hands-on execution.

  • Comfort working in a fast-growing company where priorities can change and processes are still being built.

  • Strong analytical judgment and experience using marketing and CRM data to make decisions.

  • Familiarity with HubSpot, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and related marketing tools is preferred.

  • Knowledge of the US senior living or healthcare market is highly valuable.

The Person We Think Will Thrive

You are a strong generalist who knows how to turn company goals into focused regional execution. You can write a campaign brief, improve a sales deck, develop an event plan, interview a customer, analyze lead performance, and present a clear recommendation to leadership.

You are commercially minded, comfortable working directly with sales, and focused on producing work that helps the company grow. You bring structure without creating unnecessary process, and you know how to balance brand building with near-term pipeline needs.

The Role

As part of the local Critical Operations Team, Critical Operations Technicians (COT) ensure the data center is operating smoothly and efficiently 24/7/365, with no downtime of critical services. Critical Operations Technicians are responsible for the inspection, operation and maintenance of all equipment associated with the data center. They are expected to be technically strong with great troubleshooting abilities and a desire to learn and work in a demanding yet rewarding team environment. The Critical Operations Team's on-site presence is organized in a 24/7 shift schedule, ensuring coverage at all hours of the day, year-round.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform operational, preventive, and corrective maintenance on all mechanical and electrical equipment as assigned.

  • Conduct daily and weekly routine inspections on critical equipment, rooms, and systems, ensuring compliance with quality and efficiency standards.

  • Monitor, respond to, and act on alarms from Building Management Systems (BMS), Electrical Power Management Systems (EPMS), and other monitoring tools.

  • Troubleshoot electrical and mechanical systems, interpreting diagrams and schematics to detect, repair, and report faulty equipment or unusual conditions.

  • Carry out isolation and reinstatement of electrical, cooling, fire alarm, and gas suppression systems when required and authorized.

  • Manage and react to emergency situations involving critical equipment, escalating incidents according to established processes and procedures.

  • Ensure all plant equipment operates at maximum efficiency and in compliance with industry best practices and regulations.

  • Escort personnel when required for security or operational reasons (e.g. clients and vendors).

  • Ensure compliance with housekeeping rules, facility manuals, and service agreements, managing vendor reports and follow-ups.

  • Maintain accurate logs of completed and pending work in the Facility Management System.

  • Support the preparation of technical work quotations and execution of assigned projects and programs.

  • Maintain proper storage of documentation related to building infrastructure, systems, and tools.

  • Participate in ongoing training, development, and drills to stay updated in relevant disciplines.

  • Ensure a proper handover of relevant information within the team as needed.

 

Job Practicalities / Skills, Knowledge, Experience and Qualifications

  • Preferably in possession of trade certificate and/or vocational education degree within Electrical or Mechanical discipline or equivalent.

  • Preferably experienced with electrical or mechanical systems in a critical environment and/or within a data center.

  • In-depth knowledge of various maintenance fundamentals to deal with service and repairs.

  • Ability to perform a range of complex work activities with some degree of personal responsibility and autonomy.

  • Ability to work alone or collaboratively in a team.

  • Attention to detail while maintaining a broad perspective

  • Desire and ability to learn new skills and systems.

  • Effective interpersonal skills for collaboration with vendors and clients.

  • IT and computer skills (MS Office suite) with ability to work in and learn various operating software tools and systems.

  • Good written and verbal skills in English and local language (German/Scandinavian/French/Italian languages are a plus).

  • Service-oriented mindset with a focus on client satisfaction.

 

Preferred start date: November 2026. However, an earlier start date may be discussed and arranged depending on the candidate's availability.

 

All applications will be treated confidentially.

Ethon was built to eliminate the trillion-dollar waste problem in manufacturing. We are the technology leader in Industrial AI, building agentic workflows that help manufacturers optimize cost, quality, and speed of production. We are a fast-growing team driving massive impact in one of the largest and most under-served industries in the world.

We serve the world's top manufacturers across the globe. From Siemens and Bosch to Lindt and Roche, our customers trust us to make their factories run better. We are backed by leading investors like Index Ventures, General Catalyst, and Earlybird. Our team draws from Google, Meta, Palantir, MBB, and top manufacturing companies, all here for the same reason: giving manufacturers the technology to run every factory at unprecedented productivity.

WHAT IS THIS JOB ABOUT?

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will:

  • Work directly with technical teams at our customers' factories to connect their data and workflows to our software.

  • Apply state of the art AI in challenging real world settings to drive user adoption and prove value to the customer.

  • Collaborate closely with our Deployment Strategists and other Forward Deployed Engineers to deliver value quickly and consistently.

  • Contribute features directly to the product so your customers get the most out of our platform.

  • Proactively keep the product org informed of key pain points and opportunities to make our platform better.

WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BRING?

First and foremost, we believe in curious people who are eager to learn and grow. If you're passionate about cutting-edge tech and driving major impact in manufacturing, we want to hear from you. Please also reach out if you don't check every point below.

Must-haves:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Machine Learning, or a related field.

  • 2+ years of experience solving difficult real world problems with state of the art techniques from software development and data science.

  • Fluency in Python.

  • German at C1 level or above.

  • A consistent track record of outsized impact and going the extra mile.

  • An urge to join a fast-paced, impact-driven team.

Bonus:

  • Familiarity with SQL and AI/ML libraries.

  • Familiarity with DevOps and deployment, in the cloud and on premises.

  • Experience in customer-facing roles, especially with enterprise customers.

  • Experience in manufacturing or a related industry.

  • Prior startup experience.

WHY IS ETHON RIGHT FOR YOU?

We work from our office in the center of Zürich. You will be here at least three days a week, because the hardest problems get solved in person.

Feedback loops are short. Access to founders is direct. People who prove themselves here grow fast and take on real responsibility.

Additionally, we offer:

  • Performance-based career & growth paths

  • On-site work with significant scope for flexible schedules

  • Competitive compensation including stock options giving you a stake in Ethon's long-term success

  • Vacation bonus if you take two consecutive weeks of vacation

  • Flexible parental leave

  • Learning budget for courses, conferences, and coaching

data.description:
Unleash AI Innovators, Securely

Software is being rewritten in real time. AI agents are starting to write more code than humans do, at a speed no security team has ever had to match, and that single shift is opening up the biggest opportunity our industry has seen in a decade. We're not bracing for it, we're building the company that owns it.

Snyk is building the next generation security platform where security isn't a set of tools people operate. It's a team of security agents working alongside your engineers, finding, fixing, and governing risk at the speed software is now built. These agents work alongside both the company build and the agents they adopt. Security stops being a queue of work waiting for people, and becomes a coordinated workforce companies direct and trust.

Why this role?

 

As a Staff Product Manager in Snyk's Agent Security division, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping how modern organizations build and secure AI applications at scale. You'll join a collaborative, forward-thinking team and help drive our mission to embed security into every part of the AI-native development lifecycle. This is a unique opportunity to shape early-stage products from the ground up, operating with the agility of a startup while leveraging the scale of an industry leader.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead new product discovery from idea to execution by partnering with engineers, designers, and customers to identify high-potential opportunities in AI security and beyond.

  • Validate problem-solution fit by designing lean experiments and MVPs to quickly validate customer problems and solution approaches.

  • Shape the vision and roadmap for the capabilities that you own, balancing short-term experiments with long-term strategic bets.

  • Influence the broader innovation agenda by presenting roadmap and strategy to customers, leadership, and internal stakeholders.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to take new ideas from concept to product-market fit.

What You Bring

  • You have solid experience in technology, with strong experience in a product management role.

  • You bring a strong technical background and the ability to engage deeply with engineering and AI/ML concepts.

  • You are comfortable with high ambiguity and can design frameworks to execute effectively in fast-moving, uncertain environments.

  • You have a proven track record of taking early-stage products from concept to launch within SaaS or developer tooling.

  • You have strong communication and storytelling skills to influence across teams, leadership, and customers.

It’d Be Awesome If You Also…

  • Have hands-on experience in developer security, AI/ML products, or agentic systems.

  • Contribute to open-source or developer communities.

  • Have a background in software engineering or have worked in a startup or internal incubator environment.

  • Love solving complex problems with a collaborative team.

  • Bring fresh ideas and aren’t afraid to challenge the status quo.

About Snyk

Snyk is committed to creating an inclusive and engaging environment where our employees can thrive as we rally behind our common mission to make the digital world a safer place. From Snyk employee resource groups, to global benefits that help our employees prioritize their health, wellness, financial security, and a work/life blend, we aim to support our employees along their entire journeys here at Snyk.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Snyk is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.
